title: The disappearing file
description: The setup of the exercise in Part I: a file written inside one container is gone in the next container from the same image. The tutorial does this interactively with docker run -it ubuntu bash; here each step runs as one command, with ubuntu pinned to 24.04. It stops at docker ps -a, before the exercise's questions are answered.

commands: docker run --name first ubuntu:24.04 sh -c 'echo my notes > /notes.txt && cat /notes.txt'
